title: Datamosh / Trails
description: Blend persistent previous frames into trails or displaced video blocks. Uses additional history textures.

uniforms.name: intensity
uniforms.label: Intensity
uniforms.description: Blend with the original image. Zero bypasses this layer.

uniforms.name: mode
uniforms.label: Mode
uniforms.description: Smooth trails or block-displaced frame feedback.

uniforms.name: decay
uniforms.label: Decay
uniforms.description: How much brightness the retained image keeps.

uniforms.name: blockSize
uniforms.label: Block size
uniforms.description: Size of datamosh blocks in physical pixels.
